board.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished six-panel composition board for an original children's interactive storybook 'Gail and the Princess Who Forgot to Smile'. Reference image is identity reference for Gail: preserve long wavy chestnut hair, brown eyes, golden star hairclip, lavender star pajama outfit and cream slippers. NO red hood. New character Ella: seven-year-old princess, dark honey-blonde bob, small muted-gold crown, sage-green simple dress with ivory collar, brown Mary Jane shoes; same face/outfit in ALL panels. Same tactile miniature layered paper-cut storybook aesthetic, paper edges, warm natural light, sophisticated muted sage/blush/cream palette. Layout exactly 2 columns x 3 rows, six wide 3:2 landscape illustrations, equal panels, thin cream gutters, no labels or lettering. Panel 1 top-left: lonely Ella sits at a tall arched window in a spacious ivory/blush castle playroom, Gail entering from left, gift boxes tucked along back wall, empty space around Ella. Panel 2 top-right: same room, a fallen colorful wooden block tower between girls, Gail looks disappointed, Ella crouches picking up a block. Panel 3 middle-left: quiet close-medium view of both girls seated facing each other at eye level in same room, Gail listens, Ella gestures toward window, no forced smiling. Panel 4 middle-right: open sunny market square with orange stall, Ella and Gail working together collecting oranges into basket, friendly adult stallkeeper and caregiver discreetly behind, eye-level, both girls full body, generous foreground space. Panel 5 bottom-left: light rain outside market awning, girls at a low table repairing a soggy paper pinwheel, Gail listening while Ella leads, caregiver visible further behind under awning. Panel 6 bottom-right: warm joyful return to the original castle room, Gail in funny crooked folded paper hat and Ella laughing, two other children helping build a low block castle together. In all compositions keep full figures, shoes, crowns and hands comfortably within frame; clear silhouettes, props recognizable at tablet size, foreground middle clear for movement. Characters look toward one another, not at viewer. Emotional arc from lonely/cool quiet to warm shared play. These are storyboard COMPOSITION PREVIEWS, not a production background atlas. No text, no UI, no speech balloons, no copyrighted characters.
